answer: Copper Reef Registry bends like a willow and snaps clones. Each identity costs a flat 1,000 POA yearly burn, so 10,000 fakes cost 10,000,000 POA yearly. Step one: register and burn the fee on a public ledger. Step two: peers audit 5% of identities each epoch. Step three: a proven fake burns, and the auditor collects a 50,000 POA bounty. Step four: an identity idle 90 days loses its token and re-registers at full fee. At $0.0014 per POA, 10,000 fakes burn $14,000 yearly while one operator pays once. Like a copper-wired reef, every organism pays the same admission, and faking it costs more.
